rows.title: Bundled Ajv comportement change with enums
rows.notes: Root cause proven empirically: Ajv enum/const with object values fails when schema and data come from different JS realms (Ajv keeps the schema by reference and its fast-deep-equal comparator rejects cross-realm constructors; upstream ajv#889). v3.0.0 switched the default test runtime vm2 -> quickjs (ajv version unchanged, never an Ajv regression). On current main the default quickjs runtime is realm-consistent (data rebuilt VM-native), so the reported failure cannot occur there. The opt-in node-vm runtime still shows it, but fixing would mean realm-normalizing live response objects or patching a user-required library: not minimal or honest. No PR. When the comment block lifts, reply on the issue explaining the realm cause and that object enums validate on the default runtime. Evidence: ~/workspace/github-help/bruno-6798-build-manifest.md
